sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall on Saturday at 15:00 in a fascinating clash between 3rd and 4th place. The Ramblers are unbeaten in their last five games following a recent draw, while Eccleshall arrive on an impressive four-game winning streak. This promises to be a competitive encounter between two of the division's in-form sides.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth and Stafford Town, the joint leaders on 19 points, are both in action this weekend. Stafford Town face Cheadle Heath Nomads at home, while AFC Bridgnorth travel to Brereton Social. Eccleshall's 4-game winning run keeps them in contention at 4th place. There's a notable clash at the bottom of the table as Widnes Town (winless, 2 points) visit Foley Meir. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting 5th, host Shawbury United who are struggling with four consecutive defeats. Crewe welcome Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two mid-table sides both on poor recent form. New Mills host the inconsistent Dawley Town, while Bilston Town face Market Drayton Town—both teams with mixed recent records. Allscott Heath entertain Alsager Town, with the visitors desperate for points at the bottom of the division. Telford Town visit Barnton in another mid-table encounter.
